# TOOLS

<!-- Generated by `go run ./cmd/dumptools` from the tool registry. Do not edit by hand:
     tools.TestCatalogInSync fails when this file differs from the registry. -->

7 tools. Tool names are a contract: renaming one is a breaking change.

## `chat`

**Title:** Chat with the local model

Sends a conversation to the self-hosted Ollama model and returns the next assistant message. The server keeps no history: send the whole conversation in messages on every call. The answer ends with a [uso] line with the token counters.

Annotations: readOnlyHint=true destructiveHint=false idempotentHint=false openWorldHint=false

Input schema:

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "messages": {
      "description": "Conversation so far, oldest first.",
      "items": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "properties": {
          "content": {
            "description": "Message text.",
            "minLength": 1,
            "type": "string"
          },
          "role": {
            "description": "Message author.",
            "enum": [
              "system",
              "user",
              "assistant"
            ],
            "type": "string"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "role",
          "content"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "type": "array"
    },
    "model": {
      "description": "Optional model name; defaults to the server model (--model).",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "num_predict": {
      "description": "Maximum tokens to generate.",
      "maximum": 32768,
      "minimum": 1,
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "system": {
      "description": "Optional system instruction, placed before messages.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "temperature": {
      "description": "Sampling temperature, 0 to 2.",
      "maximum": 2,
      "minimum": 0,
      "type": "number"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "messages"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

## `embed`

**Title:** Compute embeddings with the local embeddings model

Computes embeddings for one text or a batch with the dedicated embeddings model (--embed-model, never the generation model). By default it returns only a summary (count, dimensions, counters); set include_vectors for the numbers, limited to a few items. The answer ends with a [uso] line with the counters.

Annotations: readOnlyHint=true destructiveHint=false idempotentHint=true openWorldHint=false

Input schema:

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "include_vectors": {
      "description": "Return the vectors too (at most 8 texts). Default false: summary only.",
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "input": {
      "description": "One text, or a list of texts (batch).",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "description": "One text.",
          "minLength": 1,
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "description": "A batch of texts.",
          "items": {
            "description": "One text.",
            "minLength": 1,
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        }
      ]
    },
    "model": {
      "description": "Optional embeddings model; defaults to --embed-model.",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "input"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

## `extract`

**Title:** Extract information from a file with the local model

Extracts what the instruction asks from a text file read on the server, in the requested format. The file text never enters your context. Large files are split and merged automatically. The answer ends with a [uso] line.

Availability: registered only when the server starts with `--allow-root` (or `MCPOLLAMA_ALLOW_ROOT`); without it the tool does not exist and `tools/call` answers -32602.

Annotations: readOnlyHint=true destructiveHint=false idempotentHint=false openWorldHint=false

Input schema:

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "format": {
      "description": "Output format, e.g. a JSON array of {name, line} or a markdown table.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "instruction": {
      "description": "What to extract from the file.",
      "minLength": 1,
      "type": "string"
    },
    "model": {
      "description": "Optional model name; defaults to the server model (--model).",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "path": {
      "description": "Absolute path of a text file inside an allowed root; relative only when the server has a single root.",
      "minLength": 1,
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "path",
    "instruction"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

## `generate`

**Title:** Generate text with the local model

Runs a single prompt on the self-hosted Ollama model and returns the answer. Use it to offload bulk mechanical work (drafts, rewrites, extraction) to the local model; no state is kept between calls. The answer ends with a [uso] line with the token counters.

Annotations: readOnlyHint=true destructiveHint=false idempotentHint=false openWorldHint=false

Input schema:

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "model": {
      "description": "Optional model name; defaults to the server model (--model).",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "num_predict": {
      "description": "Maximum tokens to generate.",
      "maximum": 32768,
      "minimum": 1,
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "prompt": {
      "description": "The prompt text.",
      "minLength": 1,
      "type": "string"
    },
    "system": {
      "description": "Optional system instruction.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "temperature": {
      "description": "Sampling temperature, 0 to 2.",
      "maximum": 2,
      "minimum": 0,
      "type": "number"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "prompt"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

## `list_models`

**Title:** List installed and loaded models

Lists the models installed on the Ollama server and the ones currently resident in VRAM, with the server defaults. It does not load any model and does not wait in the GPU queue.

Annotations: readOnlyHint=true destructiveHint=false idempotentHint=true openWorldHint=false

Input schema:

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {},
  "type": "object"
}
```

## `summarize_file`

**Title:** Summarize a file with the local model

Summarizes a text file read on the server; the file text never enters your context. Large files are split and combined automatically. The answer ends with a [uso] line.

Availability: registered only when the server starts with `--allow-root` (or `MCPOLLAMA_ALLOW_ROOT`); without it the tool does not exist and `tools/call` answers -32602.

Annotations: readOnlyHint=true destructiveHint=false idempotentHint=false openWorldHint=false

Input schema:

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "focus": {
      "description": "Optional: what the summary should emphasise.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "language": {
      "description": "Summary language; default Brazilian Portuguese.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "max_words": {
      "description": "Optional target length in words.",
      "maximum": 2000,
      "minimum": 20,
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "model": {
      "description": "Optional model name; defaults to the server model (--model).",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "path": {
      "description": "Absolute path of a text file inside an allowed root; relative only when the server has a single root.",
      "minLength": 1,
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "path"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

## `translate`

**Title:** Translate a file with the local model

Translates a text file read on the server; the file text never enters your context. Large files are translated part by part. The answer ends with a [uso] line.

Availability: registered only when the server starts with `--allow-root` (or `MCPOLLAMA_ALLOW_ROOT`); without it the tool does not exist and `tools/call` answers -32602.

Annotations: readOnlyHint=true destructiveHint=false idempotentHint=false openWorldHint=false

Input schema:

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "model": {
      "description": "Optional model name; defaults to the server model (--model).",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "path": {
      "description": "Absolute path of a text file inside an allowed root; relative only when the server has a single root.",
      "minLength": 1,
      "type": "string"
    },
    "target_language": {
      "description": "Language to translate into, e.g. English.",
      "minLength": 1,
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "path",
    "target_language"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```
